bronze.train_partition.grain: one immutable source payload per departure date and SHA-256

silver.train_journey.grain: one passenger journey per departureDate + trainNumber

silver.station_arrival.grain: one commercial arrival event at a Finnish passenger station

metrics.completed: final arrival has a measured delay and is not cancelled
metrics.on_time_N: completed journey with final_delay_minutes <= N; thresholds N are 5, 10, 15, 30

gold.mart_regional_performance_daily.grain: one departure date + maakunta + delay threshold

metrics.observed_trains: distinct passenger journeys with a commercial arrival in the region
metrics.delayed_trains: journeys whose maximum measured arrival delay in the region exceeds threshold_minutes
metrics.cancelled_trains: journeys with a train-level or regional arrival cancellation
